title: Identify tensor reduction under normalized tensor model transport
statement: For prime l and finite E/Q_l, choose operations o, a realization m, and ringed models d [def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge]. Let W have l invertible in all residue fields, and let e identify IntegralOrdinary.tensorModel.tensor with d.tensor.ordinary.tensor with the representative normalization of [lem-sf-integral-tensor-model-identification]. The hom of tensorReductionComparison [lem-sf-tensor-reduction-augmentation] equals reduction applied to e.hom, followed by reduction applied to tensorClosed.hom, followed by the coefficient calculus reductionTensor.hom.

proof.text: Transport the strict ringed completion augmentation across e. Its representative normalization follows from the representative equation for e and equality of the strict tensor chains.
Use the defining adjunct equation for the specified tensor reduction comparison and the primitive quotient adjunct equation for the ringed model.
Naturality of the reduction/limit unit transports e. Injectivity of the adjunction Hom equivalence identifies the natural transformations.

theorem tensorReduction_eq_normalized (d : RingedModels l E)
    (o : Operations l E) (m : RealizationModel l E o) (W : Scheme.{u})
    [∀ w : W, Invertible (l : W.residueField w)]
    (e : (tensorModel l E W).tensor ≅ (d.tensor W).ordinary.tensor)
    (he : ∀ (P Q : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E W) ℤ)
      (hP : proEtaleFlatRepresentatives W ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).ring W) P)
      (hQ : proEtaleFlatRepresentatives W ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).ring W) Q),
      (tensorModel l E W).representative.hom.app (⟨P, hP⟩, ⟨Q, hQ⟩) ≫
        e.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P, DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q) =
      (d.tensor W).ordinary.representative.hom.app (⟨P, hP⟩, ⟨Q, hQ⟩)) :
    (tensorReductionComparison l E W).hom =
      Functor.whiskerRight e.hom (pullbackTensorCalculus l E W).reduction ≫
        Functor.whiskerRight (eqToIso (d.tensorClosed W)).hom
          (pullbackTensorCalculus l E W).reduction ≫
        (pullbackTensorCalculus l E W).reductionTensor.hom
